note: Realistic filled-in states in the Menstrual Symptom Severity Score engine's shape. `expected` is computed by `bin/test-personas --update` and verified by `bin/test-personas` — it covers `calculateSymptomScore`'s own return value (symptomScore, symptomCategoryLabel, firedRules) only; the independent `detectAdditionalFlags` clinician-facing flags are a separate, unchecked module. Symptoms 7-10 (impact on daily life, work, relationships, mood) are not independently rated — they are all derived as `min(3, round(totalPhysical/6))` from the six physical-symptom scores, so all four always carry the identical value. Flags: this is a split engine, so the detector is pinned as expected.additionalFlags via flagsHint "detectAdditionalFlags" with flagsArgs ["state"], mirroring form-app.js's call detectAdditionalFlags(state); the wall clock is frozen at the oracle's default while grading. personas.name: moderate-worsening-heavy-painful-periods
personas.description: Increasingly heavy, painful periods with intermenstrual spotting and suspected fibroids on a previous ultrasound, worsening over 8 months despite tranexamic acid: pain (3), flow (very-heavy, 3), pelvic pain (2), and abnormal bleeding (1) sum to a physical burden of 9, deriving an impact score of round(9/6)=2 applied to all four impact items — expect symptomScore 17, category Moderate.

personas.name: severe-fibroids-anaemia-worsening-multi-domain
personas.description: Severe pelvic pain, very heavy irregular periods with intermenstrual bleeding, discharge, and urinary frequency on a background of known 6cm fibroids and iron-deficiency anaemia, worsening over a year despite a Mirena coil trial: near-maximal physical scores (pain 3, flow 3, pelvic pain 3, abnormal bleeding 3, discharge 2, urinary 1 — physical burden 15) derive an impact score of round(15/6)=3 (the ceiling) applied to all four impact items — expect symptomScore 27 (15 physical + 4x3 impact), category Severe.
